notes:
Release notes for HC Studio version 2026.08.19.1:

- Customer Connector v2: Complete redesign to interactive CLI model. Connector now prompts user for HC endpoint, proxy settings (optional), and SQL Server configuration at runtime — no JSON files required. Single-file executable (.exe) built with PyInstaller.
- Token-only security: Removed IP allowlist and HC endpoint definitions from connector architecture. Security is now provided entirely by token-based authentication (256-bit hex). Backend heartbeat validation simplified to token verification only.
- Frontend simplification: Removed JSON bundle generation for connector. Wizard now only generates random token and downloads .exe executable. All configuration happens interactively in the connector CLI.
- Backend endpoints updated: POST /api/connector/register now accepts only token. POST /api/connector/heartbeat removes all IP-based validation — accepts heartbeat from any source IP when token is registered.
- customerConnector.ts interface simplified: Now contains only 'enabled' (boolean) and 'token' (string) fields. Removed allowedSourceIp, hcEndpoint, encryptionKey, and all bundle-generation functions.

For more details, please refer to the official documentation or contact support.
